subject: Your CanvasTrail weekend bag
preview_text: A reminder about its removable strap and internal zipped pocket.
headline: Take another look at the weekend bag
body:
Here’s a quick reminder about the CanvasTrail weekend bag you added to your basket.

It comes with a removable shoulder strap and an internal zipped pocket—two details you may want to look over as you decide whether it is right for you.

There is no need to make that decision from this email. Your basket gives you a direct route back to the purchase you began, where you can continue if you choose.

If the bag is still on your mind, you can take another look and decide in your own time. Nothing more is being asked here.
